output.summary: Agency spend growth is about 77% volume and 23% rate, so the market-price framing is mostly wrong. Vacancies and resignations began climbing in 2024, before St. Brennan's opened, and only 19 of 98 known leavers went there. The 4 West pilot, with matched controls and unchanged pay, cut charge and orientation load, exhaustion and resignations, which supports the self-reinforcing loop. The 2025 bonus did not reduce vacancies. The proposed $15,000 bonus would suspend charge and preceptor differentials while adding preceptor load, which is harmful. Extending the 4 West model is the preferred action. Rate renegotiation is acceptable but secondary. Falls evidence is confounded. Time-to-hire is unestablished.
